title: Chosen K-flat presentation of an abstract derived tensor
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian monoidal category with tensor additive in each variable and countable coproducts, using its signed direct-sum total tensor and two-sided K-flatness [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. Choose its ordinary unbounded derived category $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and a monoidal structure on it. A K-flat tensor presentation consists of: for each unbounded complex $X$, existence of a K-flat complex $P$ and quasi-isomorphism $P\to X$; and a natural transformation $Q(X)\otimes^L Q(Y)\to Q(\operatorname{Tot}^{\oplus}(X\otimes Y))$ on pairs of complexes, whose component is invertible whenever both inputs are K-flat. Thus any pair of K-flat resolutions computes the specified derived tensor. This packages the chosen tensor computation; it does not assume projective resolutions or boundedness.
